title: Tiered deposit promotion configuration
measures: answer-independent ready case next to a justified blocked case

story.summary: Promotion manager configures a tiered deposit promotion
story.description:
As a promotion manager I want to configure deposit tiers so that larger deposits earn a larger bonus.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A tiered promotion has between 1 and 5 tiers.
- Each tier defines a minimum qualifying deposit and a bonus percentage from 1 to 200.
- Tier minimum deposits must be strictly increasing; saving tiers that are not in increasing order is rejected with a validation error.
- A player who qualifies for several tiers receives the bonus of the highest tier reached only.
- A tiered promotion cannot be activated while it has no tiers.
